name: directory
title: DRVC parish locator
command: pnpm diocese roster import rockville-centre directory scratch/rockville-centre-map-1/001-survey/directory.json
notes: Built 2026-11-12 from the WP Google Map Gold places JSON embedded in https://www.drvc.org/maps/ (139 places, one per church; title, address, lat/lng, county/town/website extra fields). group left empty: the locator gives no grouping. Known slips: id 4 Blessed Sacrament (bsvs.us) has town 'Suffolk' (the script uses the map's municipality, Valley Stream); id 104 Sacred Heart Cutchogue links sacredheartnm.org (the North Merrick parish's site); some places have no street address. Script: scratch/rockville-centre-map-1/tools/locator.py.
